title: Stephanomics: Is China Winning the AI Race That Matters?
text:
The U.S. is still seen as being ahead of China at the frontiers of artificial intelligence. But Daniel Remler, a senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, argues that may not be the race that matters most. China has spent the past few years pushing cheaper, more accessible AI models to companies and countries across the developing world, all while presenting itself as the champion of nations shut out of the West’s more restrictive approach to AI. The result, he says, is a form of technological influence that could prove just as important as who builds the most powerful model. Remler tells host Stephanie Flanders why that strategy should worry Washington.Listen to the full interview on Stephanomics | Bloomberg.
